descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S04 「现成的 spec：Save & Extract 关掉和添加任务、记录用药变化，之后的 Generate 不会把记录再发给用药提取」 Existing specs: Save & Extract closes and adds tasks and records medication changes, and a later Generate does not send the notes to the medication extractor again

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing, once and with no duplicates, leaves unmatched tasks open, and records the dictated medication events.（UAT TC-14；TFA-92592 AC 2；TFA-92592 rule 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-14 step 5；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Tim's chromium specs with the model mocked at the Convex socket

When Run the four specs by title

Then Hospital Save & Extract persists an extracted task and three medication changes; Nursing Home Save & Extract closes the matched task, keeps the unmatched one open and adds new ones; a later Generate makes no second medication-extraction call for the same notes

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright verdicts. This covers the wiring only (mocked model). AI quality of the matching is S05 and TC-22. U3 is not claimed here: 'Generate does not send Save & Extract's notes to the extractor again' asserts only the medication-extraction calls (toHaveLength(1)); …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S04 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-14.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

  • encounter-workflow.spec.ts [chromium] — Save & Extract persists a model-extracted action item — expected
  • medication-detection.spec.ts [chromium] — Save & Extract automatically detects and persists medication changes — expected
  • medication-tracker.spec.ts [chromium] — Generate does not send Save & Extract's notes to the extractor again — expected
  • snf-save-extract.spec.ts [chromium] — Save & Extract saves the notes, closes and adds tasks, and keeps a codeword task verbatim — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's chromium specs): they make fresh @roundai.test accounts and mock the model at the Convex socket through the local stack's e2e helpers and admin key; dev has no admin key, no action mock and one shared account, so they run on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
